pairs: quam dedit illi Deus palam facere servis suis, quæ oportet fieri cito:
which God gave to him, in order to make known to his servants the things that must soon occur,
et significavit, mittens per angelum suum servo suo Joanni,
and which he signified by sending his Angel to his servant John;
he has offered testimony to the Word of God,
et testimonium Jesu Christi, quæcumque vidit.
and whatever he saw is the testimony of Jesus Christ.
Beatus qui legit, et audit verba prophetiæ hujus,
Blessed is he who reads or hears the words of this Prophecy,
et servat ea, quæ in ea scripta sunt:
and who keeps the things that have been written in it.
et a septem spiritibus qui in conspectu throni ejus sunt:
and from the seven spirits who are in the sight of his throne,
and the leader over the kings of the earth,
et lavit nos a peccatis nostris in sanguine suo,
and has washed us from our sins with his blood,
et fecit nos regnum, et sacerdotes Deo et Patri suo:
and who has made us into a kingdom and into priests for God and for his Father.
ipsi gloria et imperium in sæcula sæculorum.
To him be glory and dominion forever and ever.
Behold, he arrives with the clouds,
and every eye shall see him,
Et plangent se super eum omnes tribus terræ.
And all the tribes of the earth shall lament for themselves over him.
“I am the Alpha and the Omega,
et particeps in tribulatione, et regno, et patientia in Christo Jesu:
and a sharer in the tribulation and in the kingdom and in patient endurance for Christ Jesus,
fui in insula, quæ appellatur Patmos,
was on the island which is called Patmos,
propter verbum Dei, et testimonium Jesu:
because of the Word of God and the testimony to Jesus.
fui in spiritu in Dominica die,
I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day,
et audivi post me vocem magnam tamquam tubæ,
and I heard behind me a great voice, like that of a trumpet,
and send it to the seven Churches,
Et conversus sum ut viderem vocem, quæ loquebatur mecum:
And I turned around, so as to see the voice which was speaking with me.
et conversus vidi septem candelabra aurea:
And having turned around, I saw seven golden lampstands.
et in medio septem candelabrorum aureorum,
And in the midst of the seven golden lampstands was one resembling the Son of man,
clothed to the feet with a vestment,
et præcinctum ad mamillas zona aurea:
and wrapped to the breast with a wide belt of gold.
But his head and hair were bright,
et capilli erant candidi tamquam lana alba,
et oculi ejus tamquam flamma ignis:
and his eyes were like a flame of fire;
and his feet resembled shining brass,
just as in a burning furnace;
et vox illius tamquam vox aquarum multarum:
and his voice was like the voice of many waters.
et habebat in dextera sua stellas septem:
And in his right hand, he held the seven stars;
et de ore ejus gladius utraque parte acutus exibat:
and from his mouth went out a sharp two-edged sword;
et facies ejus sicut sol lucet in virtute sua.
and his face was like the sun, shining with all its might.
And when I had seen him,
cecidi ad pedes ejus tamquam mortuus.
Et posuit dexteram suam super me,
And he laid his right hand upon me,
I am the First and the Last.
et ecce sum vivens in sæcula sæculorum:
And, behold, I live forever and ever.
et habeo claves mortis, et inferni.
And I hold the keys of death and of Hell.
Scribe ergo quæ vidisti, et quæ sunt,
Therefore, write the things which you have seen,
et quæ oportet fieri post hæc.
and which are, and which must occur afterward:
the mystery of the seven stars,
which you have seen in my right hand,
and of the seven golden lampstands.
septem stellæ, angeli sunt septem ecclesiarum:
The seven stars are the Angels of the seven Churches,
et candelabra septem, septem ecclesiæ sunt.
and the seven lampstands are the seven Churches.”
